findings: Five stable Agent ActorRefs collaborated inside one Work-bound Space and one resumable Topic.
Actor-scoped Attention returned only post-subscription relevant Topic events for the five subscribed agents.
Attention and Topic use intentionally different sequence domains.
With Attention cursor 19675 and Topic cursor 5, one later message was discovered at global change sequence 19676 and resumed exactly as Topic message sequence 6.

After observer unfollow, an ordinary Topic message produced zero observer Attention events; adding an explicit mentions relation surfaced the message plus mention relation without creating a subscription.
Participation is social presence only and does not imply assignment, ownership, authentication, authorization, or EffectAuthority.

correctnessRepair.problem: Historical command receipts poisoned reversible desired-state replay: follow -> unfollow -> same follow could return existing while no subscription row existed; equivalent risk existed for joined -> left -> joined.
correctnessRepair.repair: subscription.follow, subscription.unfollow, and space.participation.set now use natural-key/current-state idempotency for reversible desired-state semantics rather than one-time historical receipt identity.

agentSkill.purpose: Teach Agents the minimal Social Work collaboration and two-cursor re-entry procedure without adding a management framework or transferring Host authority.

nonClaims: Social Work Fabric does not establish Runtime execution truth or domain truth.
Directed or small-group communication is not private/confidential by default.
Attention acknowledgement is not semantic acceptance.
Subscription is not priority or assignment.
